plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Desktop Tweaks（桌面增强）

DeepSeek Harness 桌面端修改：F11 全屏切换，终端内使用 Ctrl+C/V 复制粘贴。两个功能各自带开关，入口在 **设置 → 通用**：

- **F11 切换窗口全屏**：进入全屏时隐藏「应用 / 编辑」菜单栏与后退、前进按钮，内容顶到屏幕最上沿；退出全屏后恢复。
- **终端使用 Ctrl+C/V 复制粘贴**：终端内有选区时 `Ctrl+C` 复制、无选区时照常发送 `SIGINT`；`Ctrl+V` 直接粘贴（走 xterm 的粘贴通道，多行文本不会弹确认）。

不修改 DSH 本身，只通过客户端插件注入少量事件监听与样式；两个开关都可独立关闭，关闭后行为与原生完全一致。

## 安装

### 方式 A：插件市场（DSH 0.2.1+，推荐）

1. 设置 → 插件 → 组合包，启用实验性的「自定义插件市场」（启用后插件页会出现「发现」）。
2. 在「发现」页点「添加索引源」，填入：
   ```
   https://amstlkqp114514.github.io/dsh-desktop-tweaks/index.json
   ```
3. 搜索「桌面增强」或「Desktop Tweaks」，点安装。

> 索引是托管在 GitHub Pages 的静态 JSON，市场只校验格式、不验证声明，请以安装确认框里显示的来源为准。

### 方式 B：命令行（任何版本）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-desktop-tweaks
```

桌面端的 profile 名是 `desktop`；换成你自己的 profile 名即可。安装后重启桌面端。

### 方式 C：本地 tarball / 源码目录 / Git

```bash
# tarball
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-desktop-tweaks-0.1.1.tgz

# 本地目录（link，改代码立即生效，适合开发）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-desktop-tweaks

# Git（锁定 commit，无需构建步骤，也不需要 allowBuilds）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:amstlkqp114514/dsh-desktop-tweaks#<commit sha>"
```

### 这些安装方式有什么区别

| 方式                            | 实际行为                                                    | 适合         |
| ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| 市场 / `add dsh-desktop-tweaks` | pnpm 从 npm registry 安装预构建包，与市场安装完全同一套流程 | 普通用户     |
| 本地目录                        | `link:`，profile 里只放软链接                               | 开发调试     |
| tgz / git                       | 把包内容复制进 profile，与源目录脱钩                        | 分发、锁版本 |

本插件是纯 ESM、无构建步骤；只有带 `prepare` 构建脚本的包才需要在 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里配置 `allowBuilds`。

## 设置入口

设置 → 通用 → 「F11 切换窗口全屏」「终端 Ctrl+C/V 复制粘贴」。默认开启，状态保存在本地 `localStorage`（键 `dsh-desktop-tweaks/settings`）。

## 兼容性

- DSH 桌面端 **0.2.0-rc.2** 及以上（F11 与内置终端都是桌面端能力）。
- 市场「发现」页需要 **0.2.1-rc.1** 及以上，且属于实验性组合包。

## 已知限制

- 按 `Esc` 退出全屏是浏览器 / Electron 的原生行为，插件不拦截、不干预。
- 全屏瞬间右上角偶发的「xxx px × xxx px」是 **DevTools 打开时 Chromium 的窗口尺寸 OSD**，关掉开发者工具（Ctrl+Shift+I）即可，与插件无关。
- 只处理桌面端主窗口与内置终端；浏览器版（`dsh web`）没有窗口概念，F11 开关自然无效。

## 开发

```bash
node --check lib/index.js
node --check lib/client.js
```

调试时把仓库目录 link 进 profile，改完重启桌面端（或走客户端插件 HMR）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./
```

## 发布（维护者）

```bash
npm version patch          # 改版本
npm login                  # 登录 npm
npm publish                # 未 scoped 的包默认就是公开的
node scripts/make-index.mjs   # 重新生成 site/index.json 与图标
git add site && git commit -m "site: <version>" && git push
```

GitHub Pages 需要在仓库 **Settings → Pages → Build and deployment** 里把 Source 选为 **GitHub Actions**（工作流在 `.github/workflows/pages.yml`）。

### 想改用 scoped 包名？

`scope` 就是 npm 用户名（或组织名）的前缀，包名形如 `@你的用户名/dsh-desktop-tweaks`。scoped 包默认私有，发布时要加 `--access public`：

```bash
npm publish --access public
```

本仓库没有硬编码包名：索引脚本从 `package.json` 读取 name / version，改完重新生成索引即可。

## License

MIT © 2026 青柑橘

---

**English**: DeepSeek Harness desktop tweaks: an F11 fullscreen toggle (hides the Windows menu bar and the back/forward buttons while fullscreen), and Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste inside the built-in terminal. Both are switchable in **Settings → General**. Install with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-desktop-tweaks`, or add the market index `https://amstlkqp114514.github.io/dsh-desktop-tweaks/index.json`. MIT licensed.

plugins.description: Claude branding for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app in one plugin: the Claude Code style UI, the Claude app icon, and the macOS bundle name "Claude Harness".
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-claude-harness

One package for the whole "make DeepSeek Harness look like Claude" job on macOS.

![Claude Harness app icon](assets/icon-1024.png)

| Piece | Delivered by |
| --- | --- |
| Claude Code style UI | `dsh-claude-style` (declared dependency; installed together) |
| Claude app icon | this package — `assets/Claude.icns` → `Contents/Resources/icon.icns` |
| App name "Claude Harness" | this package — `CFBundleName` / `CFBundleDisplayName` + the `.app` filename |

Loading the plugin never changes the app by itself. Branding is opt-in (`apply`),
because a half-applied code signature is what makes macOS kill the app on launch.

## Install

Into a DSH profile — from GitHub:

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop          # or your profile dir
npm install "github:Yesyugao/dsh-claude-harness" dsh-claude-style
```

or from a local checkout:

```bash
npm install "link:/path/to/dsh-claude-harness" dsh-claude-style
```

Then add both ids to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`:

```json
{ "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-claude-style", "dsh-claude-harness"] } } }
```

Restart the app afterwards — plugin rows are read at startup.

## Use

```bash
dsh-claude-harness status            # what the bundle looks like right now
dsh-claude-harness apply             # icon + name, re-sign, rename (idempotent)
dsh-claude-harness restore           # put the original icon/name back
dsh-claude-harness apply --app /Applications/DeepSeek\ Harness.app --json
```

The same three operations are on the local web server, so the app can call them:

```
GET  /dsh-claude-harness/status
POST /dsh-claude-harness/apply
POST /dsh-claude-harness/restore
```

Run `dsh-claude-harness apply` again after every app update: an update replaces the
bundle, so the icon and the name come back as DeepSeek.

## What `apply` does, in order

1. refuses anything whose `CFBundleIdentifier` is not `com.deepseek.dsh`;
2. backs up `Info.plist` + `icon.icns` to `~/.dsh/dsh-claude-harness/backup/`;
3. installs `assets/Claude.icns`;
4. sets `CFBundleName` / `CFBundleDisplayName` to `Claude Harness`;
5. re-signs ad-hoc, **top level only** (`codesign --force --sign -`;
   `--deep` fails on the running helper subcomponents with "Operation not permitted");
6. renames the bundle to `Claude Harness.app` **last**, then refreshes LaunchServices
   and verifies `codesign --verify` passes.

Steps 3–5 are skipped when the values already match, so re-running is cheap.

## 中文衬线体

`dsh-claude-style` 的衬线字体栈以 `"Anthropic Serif Web Text","Claude Style Noto Serif"` 开头，但这两个族名都没有汉字字形（插件自带的 Noto Serif 是 802 字形的拉丁子集），所以汉字会一路回退到栈尾的 `"Noto Sans SC","PingFang SC"` —— 衬线标题里的中文全成了黑体。

插件的浏览器半边（`lib/client.js`，随本包一起加载）给栈里第一个族名补了一个**只覆盖汉字**的 `@font-face`：

```css
@font-face{font-family:"Anthropic Serif Web Text";
  src:local("Songti SC"),local("Noto Serif SC"),local("Source Han Serif SC");
  unicode-range:U+3000-303F,U+3400-4DBF,U+4E00-9FFF,U+F900-FAFF,U+FF00-FFEF,U+20000-2FA1F}
```

汉字走系统宋体，拉丁字母仍由 Anthropic Serif 出图，两边互不打扰。不装 Anthropic 字体也照样生效（栈里第一个族名没有可用字形时，浏览器继续找同族的下一张 face）。

## Notes

- macOS only (`os: ["darwin"]`), Node ≥ 22.6.
- 字体设置选「跟随宿主」时字体栈只有 `--dsw-font-family`（无衬线），中文衬线体补丁不介入。
- Ad-hoc re-signing resets TCC grants; macOS may ask again for folder access.
- `restore` puts back the plist/icon/name from the backup, not a different app version.
- The icon: 1024×1024 squircle, `#D97757`, with the Claude mark centred by pixel
  centroid. Source `assets/icon.html` → `assets/Claude.icns`.
- Check: `npm test` — `test/branding.test.mjs` builds a throwaway fake bundle and
  exercises apply → no-op → restore against the real `codesign`;
  `test/routes.test.mjs` drives the HTTP handler with a mock request/response;
  `test/client.test.mjs` runs the browser half against a minimal DOM stub.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The icon artwork follows the Claude brand assets; the
Claude Code style UI comes from [dsh-claude-style](https://github.com/Nwflower/dsh-claude-style).

# dsh-settings-extras

在 dsh 桌面版 GUI 的「设置 → 通用设置」中增加两个官方设置页没有暴露的选项：
**自动压缩阈值**与**默认思考等级**。滑块改完即生效，无需重启，也无需手工改配置文件。

## 这是什么

dsh 的上下文自动压缩阈值写在每个 Agent 预设内联的
`compaction-basic.config.thresholdRatio` 里，默认思考等级则由 provider 级的
`reasoning` 与请求级的 `reasoningEffort` 共同决定。这两处都不在设置页上，
用户要么改不了，要么得逐份改预设。

本插件补上这一缺口：

- **Host 半**（`lib/index.js`）：把设置页里选定的两个值推送到所有生效位置，
  并在每条模型请求上按该模型实际支持的档位做安全换档。
- **Client 半**（`lib/client.js`）：向「设置 → 通用设置」的 `settings.general.item`
  插槽贡献两行滑块，读写走官方设置通道 `ctx.configForms.get('dsh-settings-extras')`
  → `remote.settings.mutate`，由 Host 落盘到 profile 的配置文档。

界面文案内置中文与英文两套，样式只用 `--dsw-*` 主题 token，跟随 dsh 主题。

## 两个选项

### 自动压缩阈值

上下文占用达到窗口的这个比例时触发自动压缩。范围 **20% ~ 95%**，步进 5%，
默认 **50%**。

写入方式是**整份重写预设 config**：阈值所在的 `compaction-basic` 是预设
`plugins` 数组里的嵌套行，而补丁层只能按 id 寻址、且多个预设的嵌套行同名冲突，
所以无法就地打补丁。Host 按包名扫描所有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` 行，
因此将来新增的预设会被自动纳入，无需改代码。

上下限不是随手取的：

- 上限 0.95：取 1.0 时触发点等于压力预算上限（`floor(min(W×ratio, W−reserved−headroom))`），
  容易在压缩之前先撞上 provider 的上下文上限。
- 下限 0.2：必须高于 `retainRatio`（`compaction-basic` 要求 `retainRatio < thresholdRatio`，
  其默认值为 0.16），否则预设会在加载期直接拒绝。

阈值写进预设后**对新建会话生效**，已有会话不会回溯调整。

### 默认思考等级

未手动指定档位时使用。七档：`off` / `minimal` / `low` / `medium` / `high` /
`xhigh` / `max`，默认 **high**。生效分两处：

1. **请求换档**：在 `agent/request` 的最终配置上，按该模型实际支持的档位集合重选一档
   （取不低于目标的最小档；没有更高档则取该模型最高档；目标是 `off` 时不往上抬，
   交给 provider 自己的默认）。因为 pi-ai 路由的「模型默认档」来自 provider 级
   `reasoning`，而它是 route 级，无法表达「按模型升高/降档」。
2. **显示对齐**：把各 provider 的 `reasoning` 一并写成同一档位，让输入框旁的档位
   显示不再落到 Default。

换档只作用于**没有显式档位**的请求：用户在输入框里手选过档位的会话保持其选择。

## 仓库结构

```
dsh-settings-extras/
├── package.json          # bundle 元数据，声明 dsh.bundle.patch 与 dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 把本插件作为一条 Loader 行插入 profile
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          # Host 半：推送阈值 / 请求换档
│   └── client.js         # Client 半：通用设置里的两行滑块
├── reconcile.log         # 运行时诊断日志（已 gitignore，不入库）
├── .gitignore
└── README.md
```

依赖只有一项：`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`，声明在 `peerDependencies` 与
`devDependencies` 中，由运行中的 dsh 运行时闭包提供，插件仓库不携带 `node_modules/`。

## 安装与启用

本插件是 dsh bundle，由 dsh 桌面版按 `package.json` 中的 `dsh` 字段识别并加载：

- `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，由 Host 半作为一条 Loader 行注册。
- `dsh.client` 声明 `platform: web`，由 dsh 客户端模块系统把 `lib/client.js`
  作为浏览器半侧送出（不会自动送，必须靠 patch 行占位）。

通过 dsh 插件管理器安装，或把本仓库地址作为 bundle 加进 profile。加载后两个滑块
出现在**「设置 → 通用设置」**页，按 `order` 30 / 31 排入该页条目列表。

> **patch 行的 id 就是设置命名空间。** 它必须与 `lib/client.js` 的 `CONFIG_NS`
> 完全一致（当前均为 `dsh-settings-extras`）；改名会让已有用户的配置变成孤儿。
>
> **`cordis.patch.yml` 不声明 `config`。** 两个字段的默认值由 `lib/index.js` 的
> `Config` schema 给出，用户的改动落在 profile 自己的 patch 层上——升级本 bundle
> 不会覆盖用户已调好的值。

## 配置项

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `compactionThreshold` | number | `0.5` | 自动压缩触发比例，取值 0.2 ~ 0.95 |
| `defaultReasoningEffort` | string | `high` | 默认思考等级，取 `LEVEL_ORDER` 中的一档 |

两个字段都标了 `volatile()`，这是设置页可写入的前提。客户端滑块带有兜底值，
与 Host 侧 `Config` 的默认值保持一致。

## 实现取舍

- **触发用轮询而非事件。** `settings/document-updated` 只在 `describe()` 检测到原始值
  变化时发出，实测拖动滑块后并不总会推流。因此除监听该事件外，另有 1.5 秒一次的
  轮询读取 volatile 值兜底——读引用不依赖任何事件，是确定性的触发；值未变时既不写入
  也不产生副作用。
- **只在确实不同时才写。** `configEditor.edit` 在 `next` 与 `inherited` 深等时会删除
  该行的 config，盲目写入会抹掉用户自己固定的预设配置。所以每处写入前都先比对。
- **每轮只写一条，连续失败到上限即放弃。** 避免以 1.5 秒周期反复打 Loader。
- **不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` 包。** Client 半只 `require` 平台种子模块
  （`react` / `react/jsx-runtime`），使 dsh 升级最多导致外观降级，而不会让插槽条目崩掉。

## 诊断日志

Host 半把「本轮推送了什么、哪一条写入失败」写进插件目录下的 `reconcile.log`，
只保留最近 120 行，用于外部观察推流是否发生。该文件已 gitignore。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: Registers the github-push skill, so every DSH session follows one fixed GitHub commit, push and release procedure.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-github-flow

把「提交 → 推送 → 校验 → 发 Release」固化成**所有会话共用**的 DSH skill：`github-push`。

> Registers the `github-push` skill (plus its script) into the global skill layer, so every DeepSeek Harness session follows one fixed GitHub procedure instead of ad-hoc commands.


## 会话内一键推送

输入框左侧有一个 GitHub 按钮，点击后**在当前会话输入框填入推送指令**（不会自动发送，按回车才发送）。填进去的指令包含：

- 使用 `github-push` skill 推送当前工作区
- 推送前检查 README/LICENSE/package.json 里是否有个人账号、token、绝对路径，有就替换成占位符
- 提交信息与仓库描述不出现个人账号
- 推完给出回执（分支 / sha / 校验 / Release）

## 多账号管理

设置页「GitHub 推送流程」→「GitHub 账号」：添加账号名、切换当前账号、移除、按仓库绑定账号。

**插件不保存任何 token**：这里只记录账号名与提交身份，真正的登录凭据由系统 Git Credential Manager 保管，推送时按需重新登录。

## 推送前脱敏扫描

`POST /github-flow/scrub` 扫描将要推送的文件，报告个人账号（URL 之外的）、GitHub token、Bearer token、私钥、邮箱等敏感项。只读检查，不会擅自改你的文件。

## UI 规范

侧边栏底部按钮、设置页、浮层面板的尺寸与交互统一见 [docs/ui-standard.md](docs/ui-standard.md)。新增插件请照此实现，不要另起数值。

## 它解决什么

推 GitHub 每次都会踩同样的坑：网络时通时断、代理是死的、凭据没缓存、推完没校验、tag 指错提交。这个插件把这些判断写成一份 skill，任何会话说「推到 GitHub」都会加载它，按同一套步骤执行。

## 装了什么

| 内容 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `github-push` skill | 全局层注册，所有会话可见，`catalog` 实时刷新 |
| `scripts/gh-push.ps1` | 一键执行：探测网络 → 提交 → 推送（带重试）→ 校验 sha → 打 tag → 发 Release |

## 安装

```text
plugin_manager  action=install_bundle  target=<本仓库绝对路径>
```

插件行 id：`github-flow`。

## 设置页

「设置 → GitHub 推送流程」展示 skill 名称、脚本路径与仓库地址，并支持一键复制命令；数据来自 Host 的只读接口 `/github-flow/info`。

## 一键推送

侧边栏底部有一个「↑ GitHub」按钮：打开面板后会列出所有 git 工作区（分支、改动数、路径），填一句提交信息点「提交并推送」即可。

- 走的就是同一条固定流程（`gh-push.ps1`）：探测网络 → 提交 → 推送 → 校验 sha
- 有改动时提交信息必填；没有改动时按钮变成「只推送」
- 面板底部显示脚本输出，成功/失败一目了然

## 用法

任何会话里说「推到 GitHub」，模型会加载 `github-push` 并执行：

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "<本仓库>\scripts\gh-push.ps1" `
  -RepoPath "<repo path>" `
  -Message "feat: ..." `
  -Tag "v1.2.3" `
  -ReleaseName "v1.2.3 - ..."
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `-RepoPath` | 仓库路径，默认当前目录 |
| `-Message` | 有未提交改动时必填 |
| `-Tag` | 可选，推送后在 HEAD 上打 tag |
| `-ReleaseName` | 可选，配合 `-Tag` 创建/更新 GitHub Release |
| `-DryRun` | 只探测与打印，不提交、不推送 |

## 流程要点

1. **推完必须校验** `remote refs/heads/<branch> == local HEAD`；
2. **不猜网络**：直连与 `127.0.0.1:7890` 交替失效时，先探测再选路；
3. **凭据不落库**：token 只从 Git Credential Manager 取，不写进仓库、不回显。

## 依赖

- Windows PowerShell 5.1+（脚本保持纯 ASCII，避免无 BOM UTF-8 被按 ANSI 解析）
- `git`、`curl.exe`（Windows 10+ 自带）
- DSH 的 `skills` 服务（Host 内置）

## License

MIT © 2026 dsh-github-flow contributors

plugins.description: DSH 浏览器皮肤插件：开场动画、自定义壁纸、面板透明度，设置即时生效。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-shell-skin 🐚

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 换一层外观：**开场动画、壁纸、面板透明度**，一个设置页全管。 所有效果都在页面里完成，不碰会话、模型请求，也不读写你的文件系统。 > 名字里的 **shell 指应用外壳（app shell）**，不是侧边栏里的终端；这个插件给整个界面换壁纸和外观，不修改终端配色。

## 功能特性 | 功能 | 说明 | |---|---| | **开场动画** | 页面加载时播放一段约 1.5 秒的动画，然后淡出；系统开启“减少动态效果”时自动跳过 | | **壁纸** | 自带三张（极光 / 几何弧线 / 鲸娘）；也可以上传最多 9 张自己的图片，打开随机模式后每次启动换一张 | | **面板透明度** | 分别控制浅色 / 深色下侧边栏和面板的透明度，拖动时实时预览 | | **启动时的底色** | 应用加载前先铺上颜色，避免打开瞬间闪白 | | **设置页** | 在「设置 → 界面皮肤」里，所有项即时生效 | | **中英文** | 跟随 DSH 的语言设置，设置页文案与插件卡片都会切换 | ## 安装 ### npm（推荐） ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-shell-skin ``` 装完**重启** DSH——运行中的进程持有内存里的旧插件树。 ### 桌面应用 在「插件」页的安装框里填 `dsh-plugin-shell-skin`，不用开终端；装完重开应用。 ### 从源码 `lib/` 构建产物不入库，clone 后先构建： ```sh git clone git@github.com:raven3005672/dsh-plugin-shell-skin.git cd dsh-plugin-shell-skin pnpm install pnpm build dsh plugin --profile web add "file:$PWD" ``` ## 开场动画

三段式：底环呼吸 → 标识亮起 → 整层淡出。可以在设置里关掉，但**关闭要刷新一次页面**才生效——它改变的是插槽注册，不是纯样式。 ## 壁纸与透明度 深色主题下壁纸会更突出，因为深色面板的默认透明度更低：

壁纸的取值顺序是明确的： | 自定义壁纸 | 内置壁纸 | 结果 | |---|---|---| | 开 + 已选图 | 任意 | 你的图 | | 开 + 没选图 | 开 | 内置图 | | 开 + 没选图 | 关 | 无图，只剩首帧底色 | | 关 | 开 | 内置图 | | 关 | 关 | 无图，只剩首帧底色 | 选完文件会自动把「自定义壁纸」打开，避免“选了图却没反应”。 ## 设置页

| 设置项 | 何时生效 | |---|---| | 开场动画 | 即时（关闭会立刻移除当前动画） | | 浅色 / 深色面板透明度 | 拖动时实时预览，松手保存 | | 侧边栏显示壁纸 | 即时 | | 侧边栏透明度 | 拖动时实时预览，松手保存（两种配色共用） | | 启动时的底色（浅色 / 深色） | 即时 | | 自定义壁纸 / 内置壁纸 | 即时 | | 随机壁纸 | 即时（下次启动从已上传的图片里随机选一张） | | 图片 | 最多 9 张，支持一次选多张，每张上限 10 MB；点击缩略图切换，悬停右上角可删除 | | 内置壁纸样式 | 即时；三张缩略图，每行三张 | | 恢复默认 | 即时重置上面所有设置项（不删除已上传的图片） | 设置页底部还有两个按钮：「报告问题」打开带模板的 GitHub issue；「复制诊断信息」把版本、平台和当前设置复制到剪贴板——不含图片、文件名或任何个人信息。 ## 自定义壁纸存在哪 图片存在**当前浏览器的 IndexedDB** 里，用 Blob URL 应用到页面，不会上传到 Host： - 绑定页面 origin：换端口、换浏览器都看不到； - 不跨设备同步； - 「移除图片」只删文件，不动开关——删完自动回落到内置图或纯底色。 ## 插件市场 市场索引由 npm 上的已发布版本生成，托管在 GitHub Pages： ``` https://raven3005672.github.io/dsh-plugin-shell-skin/index.json ``` 在 DSH 里打开 **Plugins → More（Experimental plugins）→ Custom plugin markets**， 然后 **Discover → Add index source**，粘贴上面的地址即可浏览和安装。 索引包含 0.2.0 及更早的 0.1.x 版本；每次发新版后需要重新生成索引并更新 `gh-pages` 分支。 ## 桌面端差异 在 Electron 桌面应用里同样生效，但有两处观感差异： - macOS 的侧边栏用系统毛玻璃效果，会把面板透明度再乘一次，所以壁纸在侧边栏里更透； - 桌面端 `body` 本来是透明的（让原生毛玻璃透出来），铺上壁纸后这层毛玻璃就被盖住了。 另外，上传的图片按浏览器地址隔离，Web 和桌面端不会共享。 ## 已知限制 - 开场动画只在页面加载时播放一次，不会在切换设置时重复播放； - 随机壁纸每次启动只抽一次，调设置不会重新抽； - 深色面板默认 0.55、浅色 0.85，想更透可以自己调； - 壁纸按比例铺满窗口，极端长宽比的图片会被裁切（暂不支持平铺或居中）； - 除 macOS 桌面端外，Windows / Linux 上的面板透明和侧边栏透明尚未验证；如果侧边栏不透，属于尚未覆盖的平台，不是配置问题； - 上传的图片按原尺寸保存，没有做压缩。10 MB 的图解码后可能占用几百 MB 内存，一次放满 9 张时对低内存设备不友好。 ## 开发 ```sh pnpm install pnpm build # lib/index.js + lib/client.js pnpm typecheck pnpm smoke # 不启浏览器，加载 client bundle 并断言注册行为 ``` 内置壁纸的原图放在 `assets/master/`（不参与打包），打包用的是 `assets/wallpaper-*.jpg`； 新增壁纸时改 `src/client/index.tsx` 的 `PRESETS` 一处，再补 `preset.*` 两个语言 key 即可。 边改边看：把 `dev.patch.example.yml` 复制成 `dev.patch.yml`，把里面的路径改成 本仓库的绝对路径，然后在 `deepseek-harness` 目录里挂本地 overlay： ```sh cp dev.patch.example.yml dev.patch.yml # 改 name 为本仓库 lib/index.js 的绝对路径 cd ../deepseek-harness pnpm dsh web --patch ../dsh-plugin-shell-skin/dev.patch.yml ``` `dev.patch.yml` 是本机文件，已在 `.gitignore` 里，不会提交。 改了前端代码刷新页面即可；改了后端代码或调试用的挂载配置需要重启。 ## 素材与版权声明 插件内置的壁纸插图由作者使用 AI 图像服务生成，原图保存在 `assets/master/`，不随 npm 包发布。 AI 生成内容的版权状态因司法辖区而异。如果你认为其中某个素材侵犯了你的权益，请通过 [Issues](https://github.com/raven3005672/dsh-plugin-shell-skin/issues) 联系作者，附上图片说明与权利依据。确认后我们会尽快替换或移除该素材，并发布新版本。 另外说明：用户自行上传的壁纸只保存在本地浏览器（IndexedDB），不会随插件分发，也不会上传到任何服务器；由用户自行确保其上传内容的合法性。 ## 发布 版本号写在 `package.json` 里。发布走 GitHub Actions 的 Trusted Publishing（OIDC），不需要本地 token 或 OTP： 1. 改 `package.json` 的 `version`，更新 `CHANGELOG.md`，提交； 2. 打 tag 并推送： ```sh git tag v0.1.4 git push origin v0.1.4 ``` 工作流 [`.github/workflows/publish.yml`](.github/workflows/publish.yml) 会校验 tag 与版本号一致、跑类型检查和 smoke，然后执行 `npm publish --provenance`。 首次使用需要在 npm 包设置里配置 Trusted publisher（GitHub Actions，仓库 `raven3005672/dsh-plugin-shell-skin`，工作流文件名 `publish.yml`）。 本地手动发布（`npm publish`）仍然可用，但需要网页登录过 2FA。 ## 更新日志 各版本的功能变更与问题修复见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。 ## 许可 [MIT](LICENSE)

# dsh-plugin-hot-reload

标题、简介、图标和浏览器模块都按磁盘现读现发布：改完立即生效，不用重启 DSH。

A DeepSeek Harness bundle. It replaces three cached resolvers with plain filesystem
walks, so a plugin's display metadata and browser module follow the package on disk
instead of a verdict cached for the life of the process:

| Service | Why it is patched |
| --- | --- |
| `pluginPackages.metaOf` | The Host resolves `locale/*.json` and `icon.svg` through the Node ESM resolver. A package whose export was added after its first read stays bare until restart. |
| `pluginManager.listBundles` | The plugin inventory calls the Host reader directly, so it needs the same disk result even when the Host already produced a fallback. |
| `clientModules.resolveMeta` / `locatePkgJson` | Verdicts are cached in `pkgMeta`, `null` included. Moving a linked package makes its browser half disappear. |

Install it into a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <path-to-this-checkout>
```

Editing another plugin's `locale/`, `icon.svg`, or manifest then needs only a page
refresh. Editing this plugin's own `index.js`, or adding a new importable subpath
export, still needs a restart: Node caches modules by URL.

## Test

```powershell
$env:DSH_RUNTIME = '<dsh-runtime>'
$env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR = '<profile-dir>'
node test/live.test.mjs
```

The check compares this reader against the Host reader for every package the profile
depends on, and reproduces the late-locale case.

plugins.description: DSH 插件市场控制台：在「设置 → 插件」里搜索、安装、启停、卸载第三方插件，全程走官方 plugin-manager 远程接口。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-market-console —— DSH 插件市场控制台

在 DSH 的「**设置 → 插件**」分区里，加一个能**搜索、安装、启停、卸载**第三方插件的标签页。

- 目标客户端：`DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.1`（desktop profile）
- 一个包，两个半边：Host 半边是空的（只为占一条 Loader 行），全部逻辑在 Client 半边
- 所有真实操作都走官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager` 的 Typert 远程接口
- 本插件自身**不会**出现在被管理列表或搜索结果里

---

## 1. 目录结构

```
dsh-market-console/
├── package.json          # 声明 dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 挂载声明（自己插入自己）
└── lib/
    ├── index.js          # Host 半边：空 apply()，只为占一条 Loader 行
    └── client.js         # Client 半边：设置标签页 + 全部 UI
```

---

## 2. 安装

### 2.1 解析目标 profile（**绝不写死 `web`**）

```
profile = DSH_DESKTOP_PROFILE  →  DSH_PROFILE  →  web
```

实测：`DSH_PROFILE=desktop`，`DSH_PROFILE_DIR=%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`。

### 2.2 一键脚本（推荐）

```powershell
pwsh -File scripts\install.ps1     # 或者直接双击 scripts\install.cmd
```

脚本按 §2.1 的规则解析 profile，幂等地做完下面三步（重复跑不会重复追加），
并在改动前把 `package.json` 与 `cordis.patch.yml` 备份成 `*.bak-<时间戳>`。

卸载：`scripts\uninstall.cmd`（支持 `-WhatIf` 预览、`-KeepPackage` 只摘挂载）。

> **两个已踩过的环境坑：**
> 1. 本机执行策略禁止直接运行 `.ps1`，所以附带的 `.cmd` 包装器带了
>    `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass`，双击即可。
> 2. 脚本文件必须存成**带 BOM 的 UTF-8** —— PowerShell 5.1 对无 BOM 的文件按 ANSI
>    解析，中文注释会直接导致语法错误。而**写出去的数据文件必须无 BOM**，
>    否则 DSH 的 `JSON.parse` 会炸。仓库里的文件两种情况都已处理对。

### 2.3 手工三步

```powershell
$DSH_HOME   = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh"
$SRC        = "<本包所在目录>"
$PROFILE    = "desktop"                       # 来自上面的解析

# ① 放进 Node 解析路径（desktop 没有自己的 node_modules，靠父层解析）
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$DSH_HOME\profiles\node_modules\dsh-market-console" -Target $SRC

# ② 在 profile 的 dependencies 里登记（满足「实例只认 package.json dependencies」）
#    编辑 $DSH_HOME\profiles\$PROFILE\package.json → dependencies 加：
#      "dsh-market-console": "0.1.0"

# ③ 在 profile 的挂载文件末尾追加 insert 行
#    编辑 $DSH_HOME\profiles\$PROFILE\cordis.patch.yml → 末尾追加：
#      - insert:
#          - id: market-console
#            name: dsh-market-console
```

### 2.4 重启客户端（或者先试只刷新页面）

`cordis.patch.yml` 是启动时读的，所以**刷新页面不够**——但前提是 profile 没启用 HMR。

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr` 会监听 profile manifest 和两份用户 patch；启用 HMR 时，
改完 patch 会触发**热重载**：重新组合 Loader 图，浏览器跟随更新，**不需要重启**。

本机实测（0.2.0-rc.1 / desktop）：改完 patch 后未重启，`/plugins` 路由已经能提供
本插件的 bundle，内容与源文件逐字节一致。判断办法（无需认证）：

```powershell
# rev = sha1("plugin-artifact" + "\0" + 各字段长度前缀式拼接) 取前 12 位
# 字段依次是 String(mtimeMs), String(ctimeMs), String(size)
# 命中则 HTTP 200，否则 404
```

**首次安装与卸载仍建议重启**，因为这两个动作还会改动 profile 的 `package.json`。

---

## 3. 两条必须记住的契约（踩过的坑）

### 3.1 `dsh.client.inject` 填的是**包名**，不是 cordis 服务名

`package.json` 里：

```json
"dsh": {
  "client": {
    "platform": "web",
    "inject": [
      "@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes",
      "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale",
      "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules",
      "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings"
    ]
  }
}
```

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 的 `parseDshClient()` 只校验这是 `string[]`，但组合阶段会把每一项当作**模块图的排序边**（"让动态提供方先于其消费方加载"）。填 `"slots"` / `"locale"` 这类服务名，图里找不到对应 row。

**服务名写在另一个地方** —— Client 半边的 `exports.inject`：

```js
const inject = ['slots', 'locale', 'remote', 'remote.pluginManager', 'modules'];
```

两者同名不同义，别搞混。官方 69 个客户端包的 `dsh.client.inject` 全是包名。

### 3.2 Client 半边的组件 props 来自 `inject` 的**展开**

`ctx.slots.register({ ..., inject: injected }, Component)` 里，`injected()` 的返回值会被
**展开成组件的 props**：

```js
// 官方 ui-settings-plugin-inventory 的写法
function PluginInventorySettingsTab({ list, presetName, resolveText, t, useClientSync, retryClient }) { ... }

// 于是本插件也直接解构
function MarketConsoleTab({ t, data, resolveText, availableRegistries }) { ... }
```

**不要**写成 `function Tab(props) { const x = props.injected() }` —— 那样 `t` 是
`undefined`，`t('...')` 直接抛 TypeError，标签页白屏。

另外 `hooks: { clientSync }` 会被系统转成 `useClientSync` 这样的 **hook prop**；普通字段原样传递。

---

## 4. 功能

### 已安装视图

- 插件条目（`listPlugins`）与组合包（`listBundles`）分组展示
- 每条显示：标题、模块名、版本、描述、启用状态、fiber 阶段（等待/加载/运行中/启动失败/卸载中）
- **插件条目**：开关直接调 `setPluginEnabled(entryId, enabled)`
- **组合包**：开关调 `setBundleEnabled(name, enabled)`；卸载调 `removeBundle(name)`，**二次确认**后才执行
- 本地过滤框（名称 / 模块 / 条目 id）

### 官方标记与筛选

- **「官方」徽章** —— 标题旁边标出 DSH 自带的插件。判定规则（`isOfficialPackage`）：
  - `@deepseek-ai/*` —— DSH 自家发布的包；
  - `cordis:*` —— cordis 框架内置插件，**协议限定名**，磁盘上没有对应目录，只能按前缀认；
  - 第三方（`dsh-whale-widget`、本插件自己）不带徽章。
- **「隐藏官方」开关** —— 已安装视图工具栏里。打开后列表只剩自己装的第三方插件，
  下方给出「已隐藏 N 个官方插件」，分组计数变成 `已显示 / 总数`。
- **偏好持久化** —— 开关状态写进 `localStorage`（`dsh-market-console/prefs`），重开不用再点一次。
- **搜索视图同样带官方徽章，但不受这个开关影响** —— 发现新插件时把官方包一并藏掉没有意义。

### 插件备注

每张卡片（插件条目与组合包）底下都有一条备注行：

- **内置说明** —— **196 条**一句话中文描述，覆盖**全部 loader 条目**（脚本核过零遗漏）：
  - **客户端包**（67 个）逐条人工精简，从各包 `README.zh.md` 的 `description` frontmatter 出发，
    把「面向用户与维护者的 web GUI 客户端模块系统说明：宿主侧组合启动图并提供插件 bundle…」
    压成「客户端模块系统：扫描已启用的插件，把它们的浏览器代码组合起来送进页面。」
  - **host 侧插件**（128 个）批量提取后按规则收紧：剥掉「面向 XXX 的 YYY 说明，用于选择、配置或排查…」
    这类模板腔，只留主干。
  - **cordis 框架内置插件**（`cordis:include` / `cordis:group` / `cordis:timer` / `cordis:loader`）——
    它们是协议限定名，不对应磁盘上的包，只能手写。
  - 外加鲸鱼挂件与本插件自身。
  - 数据是代码里的 `BUILTIN_NOTES`，key 用 Loader 条目的 moduleName。
- **自己改** —— 点「编辑」写自己的备注，保存立即生效，标注为「我的备注」。
- **恢复内置** —— 改过的备注可一键恢复成内置说明。实现上是**直接删键**而不是存空值，
  这样以后内置文案改版还能重新显示出来。
- **存储** —— `localStorage` 的 `dsh-market-console/notes`，纯本机界面偏好：
  不碰插件本身、不碰 profile、不产生任何 Host 侧写入。
- **优先级** —— 用户备注 > 内置说明 > 提示添加。内置文案改版不会覆盖你写的东西。

### 发现视图（npm 搜索）

- 客户端直连 npm registry 的 `/-/v1/search`（该端点返回 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`，无需 Host 代理）
- 关键词：`keywords:dsh-plugin <你的词>`
- registry 可切换，兜底顺序：`registry.npmjs.org` → `registry.npmmirror.com`，失败自动换下一个
- 400ms 防抖
- 已安装的包标记「已安装」，不显示安装按钮

### 安装链路（M2）

```
inspect(spec)  →  人话化 problem  →  installBundle(spec, { requestId, registry, approvedBuilds })
                →  waitForInstall(requestId)  →  application 处理
```

- `refused` 的 7 种 `problem` 全部映射成中文人话
- `restart-required` 会**显式提示重启**（并说明刷新页面无效）
- 构建脚本待批准（`packageResult.pendingBuilds`）→ 列出准确包名 → 用户确认 → 带 `approvedBuilds` 重试
- 安装中可 `cancelInstall(requestId)`
- 版本门控拒绝时列出不兼容的依赖

### 写操作错误码（12 种）

`management-required` · `unaddressable` · `unknown-plugin` · `invalid-spec` · `ambiguous-install` ·
`not-bundle` · `not-removable` · `stop-profile` · `bundle-in-use` · `stale-approval` ·
`incompatible-version` · `operation-error` —— 全部有中文映射。

---

## 5. 自身排除（C4）

`SELF_PACKAGE = 'dsh-market-console'`，并且下列模块在列表和搜索里都标记为**只读**：

| 类别 | 模块 |
|---|---|
| 自身 | `dsh-market-console` |
| 其他市场 | `dsh-unified-market` · `dsh-plugin-shop` |
| 插件管理基础设施 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager` · `dsh-host-plugin-inventory` · `dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager` · `dsh-client-ui-settings-plugin` · `dsh-api-remotes` · `dsh-client-modules` |
| DSH 运行底座 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` · `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` · `@deepseek-ai/cordis` |

只读项的开关与卸载按钮是禁用的。判定用**段边界匹配**，所以 `dsh-baseball` 不会被误判成 `dsh-base`。

---

## 6. 故障排查

### 界面里没有「插件市场」标签页

按顺序查：

1. **挂载行在不在**

   ```powershell
   Select-String -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml" -Pattern "market-console"
   ```

   没有 → 补上 §2.2 的第 ③ 步。DSH 大版本更新时可能重写这个文件（鲸鱼插件中过这招）。

2. **包在不在 Node 解析路径上**

   ```powershell
   Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\dsh-market-console\lib\client.js"
   ```

3. **重启了没有** —— `cordis.patch.yml` 只在启动时读取。

4. **看 Host 启动日志**里有没有 `client-modules: ... failed to compose` 或
   `client bundle not found` / `declares dsh.client but exports no "./client" bundle`。

### 标签页出现了但一片空白

多半是 Client 半边抛异常。在 DSH 窗口按 `Ctrl+Shift+I` 打开开发者工具看 Console。
最常见的是 §3.2 的 props 契约问题。

### 装完没反应

`application: 'restart-required'` —— 需要重启客户端。UI 里会明确提示。

### 搜索搜不到东西

registry 不可达。UI 里换 registry，或检查该 registry 是否支持 `/-/v1/search` 端点。

---

## 7. 卸载

1. 从 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 删掉那个 `insert` 块
2. 从 profile 的 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 删掉 `dsh-market-console`
3. 删掉 `profiles/node_modules/dsh-market-console` 链接
4. 重启客户端

---

## 8. 自检与诊断

`scripts/diagnose.cjs` 一条命令走完「静态安装 → host 运行实例」全链路，逐项给结论和修复建议：

```powershell
node scripts\diagnose.cjs              # 全量
node scripts\diagnose.cjs --offline    # 只做不依赖运行实例的检查
node scripts\diagnose.cjs --url http://127.0.0.1:19387
```

它检查四组内容：

1. **C1 / C3** — profile 按 `DSH_DESKTOP_PROFILE → DSH_PROFILE → DSH_PROFILE_DIR → web` 解析，包在 Node 解析路径上
2. **包清单** — `package.json` 可解析、`dsh.client

plugins.description: Progressive tool discovery for DeepSeek Harness PTC using the official scoped registry
plugins.readme_text: # PTC Tool Search English | [中文](README.zh.md) Load PTC tool definitions on demand while preserving conversation history. Across 12 live four-turn sessions, the plugin reduced mean cumulative conversation input by **51.46% (GPT)** and **50.00% (Muse)**. Output tokens and latency are reported alongside the reductions. An independent community Host bundle using the official DeepSeek Harness scoped tool registry. Version 0.1.1 supports **Harness 0.2.1-rc.2** and Node.js 24+. ## Repeated live results Measured on 2026-10-18: macOS ARM64, Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2, CLIProxyAPI Responses. **3 runs per model per group: 12 new sessions, 48 turns and 12 real image generations.** Identical four-turn prompts cover JSON reading, terminal execution, result writing, tool-free recall, image generation and file readback. A uses the full PTC SDK; B enables this plugin. Values below are means per complete four-turn session. | Model | Input tokens A → B | Input reduction | Output tokens A → B | Active seconds A → B | Workflow completion A / B | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | GPT 6.1 Sol | 153,825.0 → 74,669.7 | **51.46%** | 814.3 → 1,161.0 | 48.01 → 64.44 | 3/3 · 3/3 | | Muse Spark 1.3 | 193,155.3 → 96,569.0 | **50.00%** | 4,173.3 → 3,728.0 | 45.93 → 43.10 | 3/3 · 3/3 | Uncached input increased: GPT 6.1 Sol: 23,521.0 → 31,405.7 (+33.52%); Muse Spark 1.3: 25,761.0 → 31,464.0 (+22.14%). These results do not establish billing savings. Input includes cache reads/writes, searches and retries. Output counts conversation-model tokens; the image service does not expose its own token usage. Active time includes tools and image generation, excluding gaps between user prompts. **Actual charges: not reported**, never treated as zero; no billing reduction is claimed. The initial SDK shrank from **35 definitions to 2**; mean first-request input fell **80.27–80.79%**. Both groups expose only `run_code` at the API level. Discovery adds round trips: mean model requests were GPT 6.1 Sol: 7.0 → 11.7; Muse Spark 1.3: 8.0 → 12.0. Output and latency need not decrease, and the SDK grows as tools accumulate. GPT had no tool errors; Muse A/B had 4/3 recoverable errors respectively, all retried to completion and included. **Image dimensions:** every call requested `1024x1024`, returned GPT 6.1 Sol: 1254×1254 (n=6); Muse Spark 1.3: 1536×1024 (n=6); exact size matches: **0/12**. Workflow success covers tool execution, arithmetic, recall and image artifacts, not requested-size compliance. Compare A/B within each model, not image speed across models. This is a small repeated sample of one fixed workflow. See the [per-run report, method and limitations](docs/benchmark-2026-10-18.md) and [auditable data](docs/benchmark-2026-10-18.json) for means, medians and ranges. ## Install Use Harness **Plugins → Add plugin**, then enter `github:hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search#v0.1.1`, or use the official CLI: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search#v0.1.1 ``` For an immutable installation, replace `v0.1.1` with the full commit SHA in the [release notes](https://github.com/hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search/releases/tag/v0.1.1). The release also provides a tarball and SHA-256 checksum. Download and verify them, then install with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./hrygo-dsh-ptc-tool-search-0.1.1.tgz`. This package ships executable ESM JavaScript: no compilation, dependencies, `prepare` script or build-script permission is needed. Restart Desktop after replacing an installed version, then create a PTC session. Remove a previous local development installation first; only one `tool_search` plugin may be enabled. Distribution follows the official [package and install guide](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish). This package is not currently published to npm. ## Use New PTC agents initially see `tools.tool_search` plus agent-owned tools. Inside `run_code`: ```js return await tools.tool_search({ query: 'bash', limit: 1 }); ``` End that `run_code`. On the next model request Harness regenerates the SDK with the selected tool; call `tools.bash` in another `run_code`. Print or return the search result once. Prefer exact callable names and `limit:1`; short English capability keywords also work. Search uses deterministic lexical matching, without network calls or embeddings. Selections accumulate for each live agent. Recreated agents, including after restart or resume, discover again. Existing live agents at installation retain their previous surface. Tools registered after agent creation need a new agent to enter its catalog. Standard/native mode is unaffected. Other policy restrictions remain enforced; discovery cannot grant an excluded capability. ## Configuration and rollback The bundle inserts row `ptc-tool-search`. Configure it through Harness plugin configuration: | Key | Default | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `true` | Enable discovery for new PTC agents. | | `maxResults` | `3` | Maximum results accepted by a search call; positive integer. | | `maxQueryChars` | `256` | Maximum query length; positive integer. | | `maxDescriptionChars` | `160` | Search result description length; positive integer. | The selected SDK retains full tool definitions. Search adds a model round trip; broad queries can load unnecessary definitions. As tools are selected, the SDK grows. Disable or uninstall **PTC Tool Search** in Plugin Manager and create a new PTC session to restore full SDK visibility. No app or proxy changes are required. ## Verification ```sh npm test npm run check npm pack --dry-run ``` Nine tests cover ranking, bounds, scope isolation, policy intersection, unload and recreation. Local macOS ARM64 acceptance on 2026-10-18 verified GPT 6.1 Sol and Muse Spark 1.3 over CLIProxyAPI Responses, including terminal calls, follow-up memory and image generation. See [acceptance details](docs/validation.md), including image attachment and file checks. No runtime dependencies, credential handling, install scripts, prompt rewriting or custom persistent session events are added. Harness owns SDK generation, guarded tool dispatch, approvals and logging. ## License [MIT](LICENSE).

plugins.description: A quieter way to keep moving. State-aware next-instruction drafts for DeepSeek DSH. 下一步，自然发生。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

![Next instruction suggestions. A quieter way to keep moving.](docs/readme/cover.png)

Download · Get started · Under the hood · MIT license

# Next instruction suggestions **The next step, without breaking your flow.** A small, considered plugin for **DeepSeek DSH**. When an assistant finishes a turn, it offers up to three concrete next instructions above the composer. Choose one, refine it, and send it when you are ready. Suggestions are optional. **A click fills your draft; it never sends a message or runs an action.** --- ### Less friction. More intention. | A little help | A clear boundary | | :--- | :--- | | **Relevant next steps** | Uses recent conversation text, open todos, tool outcomes, changed files, and the assistant's open question to propose short, concrete instructions. | | **Your words, your decision** | One click fills the composer and returns focus. Edit before sending. | | **Quiet by design** | Hides as you type, open the command menu, change sessions, or press Escape in the composer. Results arriving after 1.5 seconds are discarded. | | **A lighter model preference** | Auto mode favors names such as `flash`, `mini`, and `lite`. This is a naming heuristic, not a live price comparison. | | **Small, explicit context** | Sends limited text and tool names/targets—not tool outputs—to a provider configured in DSH, with common secret patterns and path usernames redacted. | ![Illustrative suggestion dock and composer with example content.](docs/readme/preview.png)

Illustrative interface with example content. Actual appearance follows your DSH theme.

### A simple rhythm 1. **Finish a turn.** Leave the composer empty after the assistant responds. 2. **Choose a direction.** Pick a suggestion, or dismiss it with `×`. 3. **Make it yours.** Review the draft, edit freely, and send it yourself. The plugin waits for at least two user turns. Thin context or greetings may produce no suggestions. Dismissed suggestions are filtered in page memory, capped at 20 entries per session across 50 tracked browser sessions. ### Why the next step is concrete The host keeps a compact state packet for the completed turn: recent tool calls and results (name, target, success/failure), changed files, running or recent jobs, active goal/plan, open todos, and the assistant's open question. It does not separately load full tool outputs, attachment bodies, or file contents into the prompt. The model is asked for up to five candidates. A local ranker then selects at most three by grounding (a file, test, command, or function named in the state), fit to the assistant's question, a state prior (for example, favor commit after a completed run with changes; favor fixes after a failed action), and intent diversity (change / verify / inspect / ship). This can make suggestions shorter and more specific than a generic "continue". ## Getting started **Requirements:** Node.js **22.19 or later**, DeepSeek DSH **`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`**, a Web GUI or Desktop client, and a configured model provider. The original development baseline was DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`; the full range has not been tested against every release. ### Install the release package 1. Open the [latest release](https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion/releases/latest) and copy the `.tgz` asset URL. 2. In DSH, open **Plugins → Add plugin / Install third-party plugin** and enter the `.tgz` download URL in the package field. 3. Enable **Next instruction suggestions**, restart DSH, then refresh the client. If your installer does not accept an archive URL, extract the archive and install the inner `package` directory as a local plugin. ### Install from source ```sh git clone https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion.git cd dsh-next-suggestion npm ci --ignore-scripts ``` Add the cloned directory through DSH's local plugin installer, enable the bundle, restart DSH, and refresh the client. A desktop-profile CLI alternative is: ```text dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:C:\path\to\dsh-next-suggestion" ``` This version is distributed through GitHub Release. These installation methods do not require an npm registry publication. ## Tune the experience Open **Plugins → Next instruction suggestions → Configure**, or **Settings → Next suggestions**. | Setting | Default | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Enable predictions | On | Turning this off stops new prediction calls. | | Candidates | `3` | Show between one and three suggestions. | | Provider / model | Empty | Auto-select a route, or specify your preferred provider and model. | | Host timeout | `8000 ms` | Bound the host request; the interface still has a 1.5-second display window. | | Debug details | Off | Show token counts, latency, and call count. | Automatic routing prefers models with lightweight names. When it falls back to a reasoning or expensive-looking model, it allows at most one prediction per tracked session. A provider-only setting stays within that provider; a model-only setting resolves that exact model. Choosing both overrides automatic routing. Prediction calls can consume provider credits. ## Context, with limits The plugin may send the session title, up to six open todos, up to six recent user/assistant turns, and a compact state packet (tool names and targets, success/failure, changed file paths, job labels, active goal/plan, and the assistant's open question) to your configured provider. It does **not separately load** tool output bodies, attachment bodies, or file contents into the prompt. Assistant prose is shortened and fenced code blocks are replaced with `[code]`. User messages, shell command text, goals, or todo labels can still contain pasted code or sensitive material. Common API-key/token patterns, bearer strings, long base64 content, and usernames in common home-directory paths are redacted before the request. **Redaction is best effort; it cannot recognize every secret or personal detail.** Review the provider you select and the conversation you use it with. The plugin does not separately read file contents, attachment bodies, or tool-output bodies into its prompt. It adds no analytics endpoint and does not write prediction context to disk. In-memory state is cleared on reload or host restart as appropriate; DSH and your provider have their own storage behavior. ## Built to be understood Two small JavaScript modules, public DSH extension points, and no build step. The host tracks turns and prepares model calls; the client renders suggestions and edits the draft. No core patches are required. - [Architecture and extension points](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - [Publishing guide](PUBLISHING.md) - [Host tests](https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion/blob/main/test/host.test.mjs) · [Client tests](https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion/blob/main/test/client.test.mjs) ```sh npm ci --ignore-scripts npm test npm pack --dry-run # inspect the prompt of a replay case without spending tokens node scripts/eval-replay.mjs --dry-run ``` The commands above run from a source checkout. Optional replay evaluation with your own provider (PowerShell): ```powershell # score top-1/top-3 against the message that actually followed a turn node scripts/export-golden.mjs "C:\path\to\session.v4.jsonl.zstd" scripts/golden/session.json $env:EVAL_BASE_URL="https://api.deepseek.com" $env:EVAL_API_KEY="..." $env:EVAL_MODEL="deepseek-chat" node scripts/eval-replay.mjs --cases scripts/golden/session.json ``` `npm test` covers 28 host checks and 8 client checks, including the state packet, grounding/diversity ranking, open-question code filtering, job-failure ordering, timeout, cancellation, and the actual host response rendered by the client. The replay harness uses the shipped prompt, parser, and ranker; keep exported session cases out of git (they contain private conversation text). These checks do not certif

# Opencode Connect (`dsh-plugin-opencode-connect`)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-Plugin-blueviolet?logo=deepseek)](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) [![OpenCode Desktop](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCode-Desktop%20Free%20Models-2ea44f?logo=opencode)](https://opencode.ai) [![GitHub Repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Dreftian%2FOpencode--Connect-black?logo=github)](https://github.com/Dreftian/Opencode-Connect) [![Status: Production Ready](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Production%20Ready-success)](https://github.com/Dreftian/Opencode-Connect) **Seamlessly connect and dynamically auto-sync all OpenCode Desktop free models into DeepSeek Harness.** [English Documentation](#english) • [Documentación en Español](#español)
--- ## 🇬🇧 English Documentation ### 📌 Overview & The Problem It Solves **DeepSeek Harness** is a high-performance orchestration framework and desktop workspace for advanced AI agents, multi-step reasoning, and software development workflows. However, developers often face friction with paywalled APIs, rate limits, credit-card requirements, or complex authentication setups for secondary models. **OpenCode Desktop** provides an extensive, curated suite of free LLM models optimized for coding, reasoning, long-context analysis, and multimodal tasks. **OpenCode Connect (`dsh-plugin-opencode-connect`)** bridges this gap: - **Zero API Keys Required**: Seamlessly leverages your existing local OpenCode Desktop instance. - **10+ Free Pre-Configured Models**: Instantly exposes high-capability free models into DeepSeek Harness with no billing or subscription requirements. - **Dynamic Auto-Synchronization**: Automatically monitors and syncs models whenever OpenCode Desktop updates its model registry, changes configurations, or introduces new free models—with zero restarts required. - **Native DeepSeek Harness Streaming**: Full integration with Cordis and DeepSeek Harness protocols, featuring real-time token streaming and reasoning/thinking traces (`thinking_delta` & `text_delta`). --- ### 🧠 Supported OpenCode Desktop Free Models The plugin automatically discovers and maps the complete catalog of free models from OpenCode Desktop: | Model ID | DeepSeek Harness Name | Context Window | Thinking / Reasoning | Modality | Best For | | :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- | | `opencode/beam-free` | Beam Free [Free] | 32,768 | ❌ | Text | Ultra-fast responses, linting, concise edits | | `opencode/big-pickle` | Big Pickle [Free] | 65,536 | ✅ | Text | Balanced algorithmic coding & problem solving | | `opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` | DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free [Free] | 131,072 | ✅ | Text | High-throughput code synthesis & agent planning | | `opencode/glm-5.3-flash-free` | GLM-5.3-Flash Free [Free] | 131,072 | ✅ | Text | Deep reasoning, multilingual translation, code review | | `opencode/longcat-2.5-preview-free` | LongCat 2.5 Preview Free [Free] | 262,144 | ❌ | Text | Massive context comprehension, full-repo analysis | | `opencode/mimo-v2.6-flash-free` | MiMo-V2.6-Flash Free [Free] | 131,072 | ✅ | Text | Low-latency chat & reactive interactive agents | | `opencode/nemotron-3-ultra-free` | Nemotron 3 Ultra Free [Free] | 65,536 | ✅ | Text | Enterprise code analysis & complex architecture | | `opencode/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free` | Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free [Free] | 65,536 | ❌ | Text | Instant snippet generation & documentation | | `opencode/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free` | Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Free [Free] | 65,536 | ✅ | Text, Image | UI/UX mockups, visual debugging, charts | | `opencode/space-bunny-free` | Space Bunny Free [Free] | 65,536 | ✅ | Text | Creative engineering, prompt design, test suites | --- ### 🔄 Dynamic Auto-Synchronization Engine ```mermaid flowchart LR A["OpenCode Desktop
(Local Service / CLI)"] <-->|"opencode models
Periodic Discovery"| B["OpenCodeModelSynchronizer
(Background Daemon)"] B -->|"Event: models-updated"| C["OpenCodeAdapter
(LlmAdapter)"] C -->|"Dynamic Registration"| D["DeepSeek Harness
LLM Runtime"] D -->|"Stream Requests / Thinking Blocks"| E["Agent & Chat Sessions"] ``` 1. **Auto-Discovery on Boot**: On initialization, `OpenCodeModelSynchronizer` invokes `opencode models` via standard local CLI paths across Windows, macOS, and Linux. 2. **Differential Comparison**: Keeps a snapshot of known models and computes differences. If OpenCode rolls out a new model version or introduces a new free tier model, the synchronizer emits a `models-updated` event. 3. **Hot Registry Refresh**: DeepSeek Harness updates its active provider catalog dynamically. Users can immediately select newly added models in the dropdown selector without reloading the application. --- ### 🚀 Installation Instructions for DeepSeek Harness #### Method 1: Via DeepSeek Harness GUI (Recommended) 1. Open **DeepSeek Harness Desktop**. 2. Click on **Complementos** (Plugins) in the left navigation sidebar. 3. Click the **+ Agregar complemento** (+ Add Plugin) button in the upper right. 4. In the text field, paste the official GitHub repository URL: ```text https://github.com/Dreftian/Opencode-Connect ``` *(Alternatively, you can provide the package name `dsh-plugin-opencode-connect` if published, or the path to a local directory).* 5. Click **Instalar** (Install). DeepSeek Harness will install the plugin and automatically detect your OpenCode Desktop models. --- #### Method 2: Via DeepSeek Harness CLI / Cordis Patch Using the DeepSeek Harness CLI toolchain: ```bash # Using pnpm pnpm dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-opencode-connect # Or using npm npm install --save dsh-plugin-opencode-connect ``` Or apply the included bundle patch in your `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: llm-opencode-connect name: dsh-plugin-opencode-connect ``` --- #### Method 3: Local Directory Path Installation (Development / Offline) To run or develop from source: ```bash # Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/Dreftian/Opencode-Connect.git cd Opencode-Connect # Install dependencies and build npm install npm run build ``` Then in DeepSeek Harness GUI: 1. plugins.description: SVG Studio for DeepSeek Harness: image + prompt to a pure, layered SVG. Personal, non-commercial use only; commercial licensing on request. By xiangwriter.
plugins.readme_text:
SVG Studio

Image + prompt → pure, layered SVG.
A local-first vectorization studio for DeepSeek Harness.
Built and maintained by xiangwriter.

dsh-xiangwriter-svg-studio

简体中文 · Install · Usage · Engine · Development · License

> **Personal, non-commercial use only.** > This repository is source-available, not open-source. Commercial use of any kind > requires a separate written licence from xiangwriter; see [COMMERCIAL.md](COMMERCIAL.md). > The `xiangwriter` name, mark and branding must remain intact. --- SVG Studio turns a character illustration, sticker or flat-colour image into a **real SVG made of paths, gradients and masks** — no embedded bitmap, no external tracing service. It ships as three things in one DeepSeek Harness plugin: - a full **Web Studio** page in the Harness sidebar, - an agent tool, **`svg_studio`**, for file-path workflows, - a reusable agent skill, **`svg-vector-recreation`**. Everything runs locally. Images and prompts go only to the local Harness server and the local Python engine. ## Why it exists Most image-to-SVG tools either return one giant traced path, or quietly embed the source PNG inside an SVG. SVG Studio is built for character art: it keeps the figure, refines the face locally, builds a clean backdrop, and validates that the result is genuinely vector. The original illustration is never included in this repository; the plugin contains code and synthetic test fixtures only. ## Highlights - **Prompt-guided presets.** Write what you want in natural language (“keep the wine-red backdrop, clean up the contour, more detail in the eyes”) and the engine maps those notes to colour counts, face detail and backdrop settings. Explicit overrides always win. - **Layered colour tracing.** Median-cut palette → connected colour regions → closed contours with even-odd holes → optional RDP simplification. A single colour can contain many islands. - **A figure-aware clip.** The engine samples the backdrop, separates it from the figure, handles interior holes and near-white areas, then pre-clips colour paths to the character. Background noise and stray colour blobs are less likely to become paths. - **Local face-detail pass.** A small, soft-masked palette refines eyes, cheeks, mouth and hair details without changing the rest of the image. - **Clean backdrops without invented effects.** The default `gradient` backdrop is a clean gradient derived from the source border. It does **not** add a synthetic halo or dark ring. Choose `original` to keep the source background. - **Outline is opt-in.** The extra dark outer contour is **off by default**. Turn it on in Advanced settings only when you want a sticker-like rim. - **Small, inspectable output.** Paths, gradients, a soft face mask, and no `` or `data:image` payloads. A structural check rejects malformed SVG. - **Bounded work.** Long edges above 1200 px are scaled down; the engine warns when an output gets large. Typical 240 px chibi art completes in under two seconds. - **English and Chinese UI**, with locale files you can extend. ## Install Requires a DeepSeek Harness profile with the Web UI and a Python 3.10+ interpreter with **Pillow** and **numpy**. 1. Install the plugin from GitHub: ```bash dsh plugin add github:xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-svg-studio ``` Or from a local checkout: ```bash dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-xiangwriter-svg-studio ``` 2. Install the Python engine dependencies into the interpreter DSH can see: ```bash python -m pip install -r engine/requirements.txt ``` On Windows, DSH also detects its bundled Python runtime and `DSH_SVG_STUDIO_PYTHON` if set. The Studio page shows **Local engine ready** when Pillow and numpy are available. 3. Refresh the Harness Web UI. The sidebar entry **SVG Studio / SVG 矢量化** opens the Studio. The plugin is a bundle with a Host half (`index.js`), a Web client (`client.js`), a Cordis patch, locale metadata and the Python engine. ## Use it ### In the Web Studio 1. Drop a PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, or click to choose one. Images are normalised to a maximum 1200 px long edge and flattened onto white before upload. 2. Optional: write a short direction in **Your ideas and direction**. 3. Pick a preset (or open **Advanced settings**). 4. Press **Generate SVG**. Preview, download, copy the code, or open the SVG in a new tab. ### From an agent Ask in natural language; the skill is selected automatically when the task matches it: ```text Use svg_studio on D:\art\character.png. Preset: faithful. Keep face detail on, outer contour off, clean gradient background. Save the SVG next to the source. ``` Or call the tool directly. Common arguments: | Argument | Values | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | `image_path` | local path | PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF | | `prompt` | free text | Stored in the SVG description; guides settings | | `preset` | `faithful`, `clean`, `flat`, `original`, `mini` | Defaults to `faithful` | | `colors` | 24–224 | Overrides the preset palette size | | `face_detail` | boolean | Local face pass | | `outline` | boolean | Extra outer rim, off by default | | `background` | `auto`, `gradient`, `original` | Clean gradient, auto, or source backdrop | | `saturation`, `contrast` | numbers | Small colour adjustments | | `output_path` | local path | Optional destination for the `.svg` | ### Presets | Preset | Palette | Face pass | Backdrop | Best for | | --- | ---: | :---: | --- | --- | | `faithful` | 160 | on | clean gradient | closest overall recreation | | `clean` | 112 | on | clean gradient | smaller, flatter, tidier files | | `flat` | 72 | off | clean gradient | poster-like colour masses | | `original` | 140 | on | source backdrop | scenes, photos, or when the backdrop is part of the art | | `mini` | 64 | off | clean gradient | very simple art and tiny files | The outer contour is independent of the preset and is **off by default**. ## Output contract - The SVG contains ``, ``, ``, ``, `` and a `` — no raster image. - The output is XML-validated; ``, `data:image`, and base64 payloads are rejected. - Generated files are stored under `$DSH_HOME/svg-studio/outputs/` and pruned to the newest 40. - The result is a local file; nothing is uploaded to a cloud service. ## Local API The Studio talks to three exact, local-only routes served by the Host plugin: | Method | Route | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | `GET` | `/svg-studio/api/health` | Python, Pillow and numpy availability | | `POST` | `/svg-studio/api/generate` | data-URL or file-path generation | | `GET` | `/svg-studio/file?name=.svg` | serve a saved output from the output directory | These routes are registered on the local Harness web server and are not intended to be exposed publicly. ## How the engine works ```text source image │ normalize / flatten ▼ adaptive palette

plugins.description: Bring Headroom to your DeepSeek Harness as a native plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# DeepSeek-Harness-Headroom-Plugin

![bundle](https://img.shields.io/badge/bundle-v1.0.1-CB3837?logo=npm&logoColor=white)
![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-brightgreen)
![python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.12-3776AB?logo=python&logoColor=white)
![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek_Harness-plugin-4D6BFE?logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)

Bring [Headroom](https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom) — a local-first
context-compression toolkit — to the **DeepSeek Harness** as a native plugin.

After installing, your DSH can compress large blobs on demand and retrieve the
originals byte-for-byte, and any provider you point at the bundled proxy gets
compressed transparently — no changes to your prompts.

**[中文文档](README.zh.md)**

---

## What you get

Three native tools, exposed through Headroom's own MCP server:

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `mcp__headroom__headroom_compress` | Compress a large blob (tool output, file, log, search result) → compressed text + a retrieval hash |
| `mcp__headroom__headroom_retrieve` | Fetch the byte-identical original back by that hash |
| `mcp__headroom__headroom_stats` | Session stats: compressions, tokens saved, estimated cost |

Two ways to use them, and they are independent:

**1. On-demand tools — works with any provider.** The model decides when to call
them. Nothing about your traffic changes; you gain compression only when the agent
chooses to use it.

**2. Transparent compression — an HTTP proxy.** Every byte of traffic through a
repointed provider is compressed automatically, whether or not the model asks.
Measured on a 500-row tool result:

```
before    : 27665 tokens
after     : 18812 tokens
saved     :  8853 tokens  (32.0%)
transform : router:smart_crusher:0.54
```

The FATAL row (id 67) survived compression, and the model still answered with it.
Compression is **reversible**: originals live in a local store and come back
byte-identical, so nothing is lost — it is only deferred. Byte-identity is a
property of the *store*, not of the compacted text: what the model reads inline is
lossy, and the original is recovered by asking for it.

## Install

**Prerequisites:** a working DSH profile, and `uv`/`uvx` on `PATH`.

If `uvx --version` does not print a version yet, install `uv` first — it is the one
prerequisite, and the same command works on Windows, macOS and Linux:

```bash
# macOS / Linux
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

# Windows (PowerShell)
powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex"

# or, if you already have Python and pip
pip install uv
```

Reopen the terminal afterwards and check `uvx --version`. Nothing else is
required: `uvx` fetches Headroom and all of its Python dependencies by itself,
so there is no Python environment to create and no package to build.

Clone this repository anywhere you like — the MCP row starts `uvx` from `PATH`, so
it does not care where the bundle is installed; only the `install_bundle` step
needs an absolute path to locate the bundle.

```bash
git clone <this-repo> dsh-headroom
cd dsh-headroom
```

Nothing needs building. Headroom itself is fetched by `uvx` on first use, and the
proxy environment is created on demand by its launcher.

### Step 1 — nothing to configure

The shipped patch is zero-config — it pulls up the upstream `headroom mcp serve`
directly via `uvx` on `PATH`, so there is nothing to edit:

```yaml
command: uvx
args:
  - '--from'
  - 'headroom-ai[mcp]'
  - 'headroom'
  - 'mcp'
  - 'serve'
env:
  HEADROOM_BEACON: 'off'
  HEADROOM_UPDATE_CHECK: 'off'
  HEADROOM_TIKTOKEN_LOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: '120'
failOnStartupError: true
```

`command` has no directory component, and the stdio transport resolves it through
the `PATH` (`cross-spawn`), so neither the install location nor the Host's working
directory matters any more — which is exactly what makes a config-only patch
portable. `uvx` is the same name on Windows (`uvx.exe`), macOS, and Linux, so the
MCP row has no `.cmd`/`.sh` platform split. `args` reaches the child as the argv
verbatim, so `headroom-ai[mcp]` needs no quoting.

### Step 2 — install the bundle

```
plugin_manager  action=install_bundle  target=<absolute-path-to-this-repo>\plugin
```

That runs `pnpm` in your profile, links `@local/dsh-headroom` into
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules`, and applies the patch to the live
profile. Success reports `application: applied` with empty `warnings`. Restart
DSH if your profile is not the live one. Once installed, the `headroom-mcp` row is
`active` and the three `mcp__headroom__*` tools are immediately usable — no need
to launch the Harness from any particular directory.

> This one path is unavoidably absolute — `install_bundle` is told *where the
> bundle is* by you. Everything after it is relative.

### Step 3 — remove it again

```
plugin_manager  action=remove_bundle  target=@local/dsh-headroom
```

### A note on environment variables

DSH scrubs the environment it hands to MCP children: any name matching
`/KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN/i` is dropped, as is any name beginning with `DSH_`
(`dsh-subprocess/lib/index.js:32,52`). This bundle's variables are all named
`HEADROOM_*`, so they pass through untouched — but it is worth knowing before you
add a credential-style name of your own.

`HEADROOM_DSH_WORKSPACE` overrides the launchers' workspace detection. You only
need it if you invoke a launcher from a relocated or symlinked location.

## Verifying the install

[`plugin/verify/verify_headroom.py`](plugin/verify/verify_headroom.py) proves the
whole chain end-to-end — the sanitizer, model discovery, a real SSE stream, and
an actual compression:

```
.proxy-venv/Scripts/python.exe plugin/verify/verify_headroom.py \
    --credentials ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml
```

```
==========================================================================
summary
==========================================================================
  header     PASS
  discovery  PASS
  stream     PASS
  compress   PASS

OVERALL: PASS
```

Each check prints its own `RESULT: PASS` line with the numbers it observed, so a
failing run says which stage failed and why. `--only header` runs the offline
check that needs no key and no network. Exit code is non-zero on failure, so it
drops straight into CI.

[`plugin/README.md`](plugin/README.md) additionally documents the MCP handshake
check and the other manual verification steps.

## Transparent compression (the proxy)

Start the proxy — **nothing auto-starts it**, and it needs to be told where to
forward:

```powershell
plugin\bin\headroom-proxy.cmd https://your-provider.example/v1
```

There is deliberately **no built-in upstream**. A proxy that silently forwarded to
an endpoint you did not choose would send your content and your API key somewhere
unexpected, so the launcher exits with an error instead of guessing. Give it an
argument, `HEADROOM_UPSTREAM_URL`, or a pre-existing `OPENAI_TARGET_API_URL`.

Then point a provider's `baseURL` at it:

```yaml
# your profile's cordis.patch.yml, inside an llm-pi-ai provider
baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1
```

The proxy forwards to `OPENAI_TARGET_API_URL` and passes the client's
`Authorization` header through unchanged, so the provider key stays whatever DSH
already sends — nothing is duplicated, intercepted, or stored. Per-request token
accounting appears in the response headers (`x-headroom-tokens-before/after/saved`,
`x-headroom-transforms`), and running totals land in
`.headroom/savings_events.jsonl`.

Three settings matter, and all three were necessary here:

| Setting | Value | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--mode` | `token` | `cache` mode freezes prior turns to protect the provider's prefix cache; a frozen payload is never compressed, which measured **zero** savings. `token` mode does not freeze. Both modes behave identically on content neither one freezes. |
| `HEADROOM_HF_TOKENIZER_LOAD_TIMEOUT_SECS` | `0` | The HF tokenizer download never completes here, so every request stalled for the full timeout (~10s). Disabling the fetch cut `opt_ms` from ~10000ms to 26–66ms. |
| A patched venv | via `bin/setup-proxy

plugins.description: DSH plugin: switch the session terminal tool from pwsh to the local Git Bash on Windows.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-terminal-tool

在 Windows 上把模型的终端工具从 **pwsh** 换成 **本机 Git Bash** 的 DSH 插件。

设计取向：**一个开关、所有 preset 跟随、不动 preset 文件、不接管全局 `ctx.shell`**。默认 `dialect: pwsh`，装上去什么都不变；改成 `bash` 后，**新会话**拿到 `bash` 工具、`pwsh` 从该会话的工具目录里消失，已开的会话保持原状。

> **临时替代方案**：DSH 目前没有内置的「终端 / Git Bash 选择」能力。**在官方能力落地前，本插件是它的临时替代方案**——用官方已发布的执行器与工具，把 Windows 上新会话的终端换成 Git Bash；Windows 受限沙箱档位下的 `confinedPolicy` 同属这段临时接线。**官方提供等价设置后即可停用本插件**：从 profile 依赖里移除本行并重启，新会话即回到官方终端工具。插件不改 DSH 安装目录、不改任何 preset、不接管全局 `ctx.shell`，配置只写进当前 profile 的 patch 层；卸载不需要清理任何全局状态。`minimalMode: variant` 是这条界线上的例外，但不是对它的破坏：持久终端版本以**新增预设** `minimal-gitbash` 的形式注册，官方 `minimal` 预设原样保留；没有会话再引用它时，这个预设会自行消失。详见[极简模式](#极简模式minimal-preset)。

---

## 为什么要这个插件

DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的平台组合在 Windows 上是互斥的：

```yaml
- id: bash-sandbox
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
  disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
- id: pwsh-sandbox
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
  disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
- id: tool-bash          # 同样的平台断言
- id: tool-pwsh
```

`ctx.shell` 是单实例服务（同一 context 内加载第二个会抛错），所以 Windows 上根本没有 bash 执行器，`bash` 工具也不存在。想用 Git Bash 只有三条路：

| 路线 | 代价 |
|---|---|
| 改 `dsh-base` / profile patch 的平台断言 | 要动第一方组合，重启，且只影响那一个平面 |
| 自研 PTY / 自研工具 | 重写 60KB+ 的工具契约，容易与官方行为漂移 |
| **本插件：会话级隔离替换** | 只在新会话的 `isolate('shell')` 子树里注入执行器，宿主平面不动 |

本插件选第三条。

---

## 工作原理

插件本身不实现终端。它做四件事，全部复用第一方组件（官方 `minimal` 预设另有一个变体入口，见[极简模式](#极简模式minimal-preset)）：

1. **执行器**：`GitBashExecutor extends LocalBashExecutor`，只改三处——
   - `execute()` 用配置的 `bash.exe` 绝对路径组 `[bash, -c, command]`（基类硬编码 `"bash"`，在 Windows 上会命中 `System32\bash.exe`，那是 WSL 启动器）；
   - `resolve()` 注入 `PATH`（`spawnSpec` 里 `spec.env` 是唯一能塞 PATH 的位置）；
   - 受限档位下按 `confinedPolicy` 选择直接启动、走官方 `ctx.sandbox.confine()`，还是明确报错（见「受限沙箱策略」）。

   超时、输出收集与溢出、abort 分类、`dshEnv` 合并、结果整形全部继承，行为与官方 bash 执行器一致。

2. **工具本体**：直接挂官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash`。前台/后台、超时转后台、`sandbox_permissions` 升级、会话 cwd、工具卡片、退出码标记，官方自带。

3. **会话级替换**（`src/replace.ts`，在 `agent/created` 里执行）：
   ```
   shellCtx = agentCtx.isolate('shell')       // 该 agent 私有的 shell realm
   shellCtx.plugin(GitBashExecutor, {...})    // 只在这个子树里可见
   shellCtx.plugin(ToolBash, {...})           // 注册出的 bash 落在 agent 自己的工具层
   agentCtx.tools.restrict({ deny: ['pwsh'] })          // 只过滤「继承来的」工具
   agentCtx.systemPrompt.section({ name: 'tool:pwsh', text: '' })  // 空文本=渲染时丢弃
   ```
   四步都登记在 `agentCtx` 上，会话结束由 cordis 逆序释放；中途失败则逆序回滚，会话退化为原样。

4. **配置与设置行**：所有字段 `.volatile()`，同一份 entry Config 由 Host 交给官方 `configForms` 服务；**客户端半区**（`lib/client.js`）把它渲染成 **设置 → 通用 → 终端工具** 的一行，写回仍落在 profile 的 patch 层。行内控件全部复用官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 的 `Button` / `Input` / `Menu` / `IconChevronDownOutlineRegular`，外观与相邻的官方设置项同源；该包只作为 devDependency 提供类型，运行时由 Web shell 的冻结模块表（`PLATFORM_MODULES`）播种，bundle 像 `require('react')` 一样 `require()` 它，插件不在运行时安装任何依赖。

### 关键设计约束（为什么不那么做）

- **不接管全局 `ctx.shell`**：那会让所有会话（包括没选 bash 的）跟着变，并且与宿主平台的执行器冲突。
- **不编辑 preset**：`preset-standard` 在 profile 里是完整快照，改它等于接管用户的组合文件，且升级会被覆盖。极简模式的变体同理——它是**新增**一个注册项（`minimal-gitbash`），不是改官方 `minimal` 的定义。
- **只对新会话生效**：工具与 prompt 是会话创建时装配的，运行中换不掉——这是 DSH 的语义，不是插件的取舍。
- **`restrict` 只过滤继承层**：官方文档明确 "never what its OWN layer registers"，所以从 agent scope 调 `restrict({deny:['pwsh']})` 恰好只隐藏 preset 带进来的 `pwsh`，不影响本层注册的 `bash`。
- **沙箱策略是显式配置，不由插件悄悄绕过**：默认 `confinedPolicy: unconfined` 在 Windows 受限档位下直接启动 Git Bash，命令因此不受文件沙箱约束——这是用户在设置里看得到、可改回的选择；`escalate` 仍走官方 `ctx.sandbox.confine()` 与官方审批，`fail` 明确报错。插件只把 MSYS 启动失败分类成 `denied`，不自己实现审批。

---

## 安装

### 前置条件

- Windows + DSH Desktop `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`（`package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 范围；本插件在此范围内开发与验证）
- **Web shell 自带 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`**：0.2.1-rc.2 起该包由 Web shell 的冻结模块表（`PLATFORM_MODULES`）播种，插件设置行的 bundle 像 `require('react')` 一样 `require()` 它，不会内联第二份 atoms。宿主升级到范围外时设置行可能加载失败，但 Host 半区的替换逻辑不依赖这张模块表
- 本机已装 Git for Windows（或 MSYS2 / Cygwin）
- Windows 受限沙箱下 Git Bash 无法在沙箱内启动：默认 `confinedPolicy: unconfined` 直接启动（模型命令不受文件沙箱限制），也可选 `escalate`（官方审批）或 `fail`（报错），见「受限沙箱策略」

### 步骤

```powershell
# 1. 构建（产物在 lib/）
git clone https://github.com/road-kid/dsh-terminal-tool.git
cd dsh-terminal-tool
npm install
npm run check        # typecheck → build → contractcheck → clientsmoke → selftest → rowselftest → rendertest → integration → ptytests

# 2. 装进 profile（本机 profile 为 desktop）
#    用插件管理器从本地目录安装：
#    plugin_manager install_bundle → target = 本仓库的绝对路径
npm pack
# 或把 tarball / 目录放进 profile 的依赖里，例如
#   C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json
```

插件包自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`，profile 的组合层会读取它并插入：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: terminal-tool
      name: dsh-terminal-tool
      disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
```

**安装或升级后必须重启 DSH**：运行中插入的 row 只进组合树，插件的 `apply` 不会被调用。

### 启用

重启后打开 **设置 → 通用**，底部会多出一行 **终端工具**（客户端半区注册的 `settings.general.item` 行，id `terminal-tool`，order 60）：

```
终端工具                                     [Git Bash（bash） ▾]
模型执行命令时使用的终端；改动只影响新会话。
Git Bash 路径                    [C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe]  [自动发现]
```

（上面是选中 `bash` 后的样子；默认 `pwsh` 时没有第二行。）

- **版式与官方 General 段设置行一致**：两列，左侧标题（14px/20px）+ 一句说明（12px/18px），右侧控件；24px 列间距、16px 纵向内边距、`.5px` 底部分隔线（`--dsw-alias-border-l2`）。颜色全部取 `--dsw-alias-*` 设计变量，跟随主题。
- **终端类型**是一枚官方下拉触发器（36px、`--dsw-radius-md`、`--dsw-alias-bg-module-platform`、chevron），点开是官方 `Menu`——与官方段里所有枚举型偏好的渲染方式相同。**默认 `pwsh`**：装插件本身不改变任何行为。
- 选 `bash` 后才出现路径行。路径默认是官方 `Input`，直接填 `bash.exe` 的完整路径；「自动发现」命中多于一条时，输入框换成同一套下拉，列出全部可用路径。路径为空时有提示；扫描中按钮文案变为「正在扫描…」，扫不到会明确提示，而不是清空输入。
- 已经选好的路径**不会**被后续扫描改写（除非它已失效）。
- `bash` 时路径行之后还有 **受限沙箱时** 下拉（`unconfined` / `escalate` / `fail`，默认 `unconfined`）；选中 `unconfined` 会显示提示：模型执行的命令不受文件沙箱限制。三种取值的后果见「受限沙箱策略」。
- 再下一行是 **极简模式** 下拉（`leave` / `oneshot` / `variant`，默认 `oneshot`），只在方言为 `bash` 且平台受支持时出现，用于处理官方 `minimal` 预设的持久终端。选 `variant` 后行内会显示变体状态：已注册 / 注册失败（带原因）；关掉选项但仍有会话引用时，提示里会给出引用数。见[极简模式](#极简模式minimal-preset)。
- **挂载时不扫描、不写配置**：扫描只在点「自动发现」时发生，并把选中的 `bashPath` 与可用列表 `bashCandidates` 原子写回；`/state` 只读配置，所以打开设置是瞬时的。运行中的会话保持启动时的终端类型——这是 DSH 的装配语义。
- 能力或设置服务不可用时行内会说明原因（例如「当前 DSH 版本不支持自动切换：{reason}」）；配置只读时所有控件禁用。非 Windows 上整行不渲染。

设置行通过两条 `/api` 路由（都不写配置；写入仍走 `configForms`，落 profile patch 层）：

| 路由 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `POST /api/dsh-terminal-tool/state` | 平台、设置可用性、当前值、能力探测。**不扫描**，所以打开设置是瞬时的 |
| `POST /api/dsh-terminal-tool/discover` | 用户点「自动发现」时才调用，返回全部可用候选 |

Config 字段（设置行直接编辑 `dialect`、`confinedPolicy` 与 `bashPath`；点「自动发现」会原子写回 `bashPath` + `bashCandidates`；其余字段仍可直接写 profile patch）：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `dialect` | `pwsh`（默认，行为不变）/ `bash` |
| `bashPath` | 显式 bash.exe 绝对路径；留空 = 自动发现 |
| `bashCandidates` | 上一次「自动发现」的可用路径（也接受手填的安装根目录） |
| `autoDiscover` | 会话装配时 `bashPath` 为空是否自动发现 |
| `discoverTimeoutMs` | 一次发现的上限（只 stat 文件，不 spawn） |
| `loginShell` | 传 `-l`，读取登录 profile |
| `extraPath` | 追加到子进程 PATH 的目录 |
| `pythonUtf8` | 导出 `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` |
| `confinedPolicy` | Windows 受限档位下的处理方式：`unconfined`（默认，直接启动，不经文件沙箱）/ `escalate`（先走官方沙箱；首次失败返回官方 denial 提示，模型带 `sandbox_permissions` 重试并审批）/ `fail`（抛 `SandboxUnavailableError`，提示改配置） |
| `minimalMode` | 官方 `minimal` 预设的处理方式：`leave`（保留官方持久终端）/ `oneshot`（默认，旧行为，换成一次性 `bash`）/ `variant`（另注册持久 Git Bash 预设 `minimal-gitbash`）。只影响 `minimal` 会话 |
| `timeoutMs` / `maxTimeoutMs` / `maxOutputBytes` / `maxSpillBytes` / `graceMs` | 继承自官方 bash 执行器的同名字段 |

把 `dialect` 改成 `bash`，**新建会话**即可看到工具目录里是 `bash` 而不再是 `pwsh`。已开的会话不受影响。

---

## 自动发现顺序

`bashPath` 为空且 `autoDiscover` 为真时，按下列顺序找，命中即止：

1. `bashCandidates` 里的每一项（展开为 `bin\bash.exe` / `usr\bin\bash.exe`）
2. 注册表 `HKLM\SOFTWARE\GitForWindows` 的 `InstallPath`
3. `%ProgramFiles%\Git`、`%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Git`、`%LocalAppData%\Programs\Git`
4. `%ProgramFiles%\MSYS2`、`C:\msys64`、`%LocalAppData%\MSYS2`
5. `%SystemDrive%\cygwin64`、`%SystemDrive%\cygwin`
6. PATH 上 `git.exe` 反推（`<root>\bin\bash.exe`）

**WSL 被硬排除**：`C:\Windows\System32\bash.exe` 和 `WindowsApps\bash.exe` 都不是 Git Bash，交给执行器会得到另一个操作系统和另一套文件系统。

发现只做文件系统探测（`statSync`）+ 一次异步 `reg.exe query`，**不会 spawn `bash --version`**——宿主在 `agent/created` 里串行派发事件，同步 spawn 会卡住整个进程。

---

## PATH 组装

执行时子进程 PATH = `工具链 bin` → `usr\bin` → `bin` → `usr\local\bin` → `extraPath` → **宿主 PATH**。

顺序是有意的：MSYS2 的 `git`/`ls`/`grep` 必须赢过 Windows 上的同名同源工具，而宿主 PATH 必须保留，否则 `node`/`python` 等原生命令会消失。去重按「小写 + 去尾分隔符 +

plugins.description: A per-turn token usage strip for DeepSeek Harness: a segmented bar plus a written legend in every reply's icon row, showing this turn's uncached input / cache read / output split.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-token-bar

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-token-bar.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-token-bar)
[![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 Web 界面加一条**单轮 token 用量条**：放在每条回复自己的图标行里（复制 / 分支 / 用量 / 时间那一行），把这一轮的缓存结构画成灰 / 黄 / 绿三段条，配一条带百分比的完整图例。

![回复图标行里的单轮用量条：灰=未缓存输入、黄=缓存读取、绿=输出，后面跟带百分比的图例](docs/screenshot-turn-bar.png)

**极轻量**：纯客户端展示，不联网、不落盘、不注册任何 Host 路由、不写会话日志、不改任何官方包。
**零依赖**：一个手写 bundle，只用平台提供的 React。

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

---

## 它解决什么

官方在每条回复末尾的用量气泡里，点开能看到「本轮用量」的精确数字。但**数字是列表，要读；结构是形状，一眼就懂**：

- 这一轮是不是全命中缓存？
- 有没有跑出大量未缓存输入（意味着前缀失效、成本变高）？
- 输出占比是否异常？

`dsh-token-bar` 把这三个数字变成一条可扫视的带状图，并且带图例——**不需要悬停也知道每段是什么、占多少**。

## 外观

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 段序 / 图例序 | **灰（未缓存输入）→ 黄（缓存读取）→ 绿（输出）**，条与图例完全同序 |
| 条宽 | 132px |
| 最小段宽 | 只要有 token 就至少 **6px**，再小的占比也看得见，不会和图例对不上 |
| 图例 | 色点 + 名称 + 本轮占比百分比 |
| 字号 | 比正文小一号：`calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary, 13px) - 1px)`，跟随设置里的字号 |
| 配色 | 全部取自 `--dsw-*` 主题 token，浅色 / 深色自动跟随 |
| 对齐 | 图标行内垂直居中 |

悬停显示本轮完整明细：缓存命中率 + 每段精确 token 数与占比。

> 缓存写入未单独成段——当前路由上该值恒为 0。

## 数据来源

读本轮 `turn-tail` location data 里的 `tokenUsage`，即**本轮**的用量（和官方「本轮用量」弹窗同源），**不是**会话累计。

`conversation.chat.assistant-actions` 这个插槽只把**消息 id** 交给组件，所以 `useChat` 会从本轮数据反查一次：每条完成的 Turn 都会发布一份 `turn-tail`，里面既有收尾消息的 `messageId`，也有它自己的 `tokenUsage`——对上 id 就拿到了这一轮的账目。`useChat` 属于会话级插槽标配（`dsh-client-ui-chat` 的 `slots.d.ts` 把 `useChat` 挂在 `SessionStandardProps` 上），不需要额外注入。

感谢 [dsh-token-counter](https://github.com/OkliaoliO/dsh-token-counter) 提供的实现参考。

## 安装

已发布到 npm：[dsh-token-bar](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-token-bar)

```sh
# 从 npm 安装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-token-bar

# 或直接用 npm 装进项目
npm i dsh-token-bar
```

或从本地目录安装（开发时）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-token-bar
```

安装后**重启 `dsh web`** 生效。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-token-bar
```

## 兼容性

| 组件 | 支持 |
|---|---|
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`，在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 上实测 |
| Node.js | `>=20` |
| 界面 | DSH Web（依赖 `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` 插槽） |
| 系统 | macOS / Linux / Windows（纯 JavaScript） |

## 开发

```sh
npm run check   # 语法检查
npm test        # 纯函数测试 + 渲染测试
```

`npm test` 默认测试**源码** `client.js`。想验证浏览器实际收到的那份构建产物，从运行中的 `dsh web` 抽一份快照：

```sh
node scripts/snapshot-bundle.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=<启动时打印的 token>"
npm test        # 检测到 verify-module.js 后，自动改为测试服务端下发的产物
```

### 网络受限时推送

如果所在网络访问不了 `github.com:443`（`git push` 卡住超时）但 `api.github.com` 可以访问，用 REST API 推送：

```sh
node scripts/push-via-api.mjs <owner>/<repo> --dry-run   # 先看要推什么
node scripts/push-via-api.mjs <owner>/<repo>             # 真正推送
```

它会按 blobs → trees → commits 重放本地历史，并把分支指向**远端生成的**新 commit SHA（API 创建的 commit 与本地 SHA 不同，这点最容易踩坑）。

## 可调参数

都在 `client.js` 顶部：

| 常量 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `BUCKETS` | 三段（顺序、名称、颜色） |
| `MIN_SEGMENT_PX` | 最小段宽，默认 `6` |
| `TRACK_PX` | 条宽，默认 `132` |
| `FONT_SIZE` | 字号，默认比正文小一号 |

## 已知限制

- 只覆盖完成（`turn/end`）的轮次；正在流式输出的那一轮没有条。
- **图标行常驻**：官方默认只让最新一条回复的图标行常驻，更早的回复要悬停才淡入。为了让条一直看得见，插件把助手那一行固定为可见——只动带 `data-clock="end"` 的行，用户气泡不受影响。代价是每条回复下方的图标行都常显。
- **位置受官方排列约束**：那一行的顺序是硬编码的（复制 → 插件动作 → 分支 → 用量 → 时间），唯一可用的插件插槽在复制与分支之间。所以条落在用量左侧，而不是「用量和时间之间」——官方没有在那里留插槽。
- 依赖官方 `turn-tail` 的 location data 结构；DSH 若改动该结构，需要跟随适配。
- 没有设计器 / 配置界面，改样式需要编辑源码。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# no-need-workspace

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness bundle that adds a **No workspace** action to the blank-session
workspace picker. It defers the folder until the first message and keeps all such
sessions grouped under one **No Need Workspace** parent.

## Preview

![The No workspace option at the bottom of the workspace picker](docs/screenshot.png)

The blank-session workspace picker with **No workspace** selected.

## Behavior

- Clicking **No workspace** only ensures and selects the shared bucket workspace
  at `$DSH_HOME/workspaces`; it does not create a per-session folder.
- The first message in that session creates
  `$DSH_HOME/workspaces/YYYY-MM-DD_HH-mm-ss` (a numeric suffix is added when the
  same second already has a folder) and switches the session's working directory
  to it.
- The session header keeps pointing at the bucket, so the left sidebar shows
  every such session under the **No Need Workspace** group. Timestamped folders
  are not registered as separate workspaces and therefore do not form a folder
  tree.
- The existing **Add workspace…** action still uses the composed directory
  picker; the sidebar `+` action is unchanged.

`$DSH_HOME` is the configured Harness home (`$DSH_HOME`), falling back to
`~/.dsh`. No folders are deleted automatically.

## Install

DSH ships its plugin manager as a bundle. Install `no-need-workspace` from the
Web **Plugins** page by package name, or through the `plugin_manager` agent tool:

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "no-need-workspace@0.2.1" }
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so installation selects the bundle and
inserts its single Host/Client row.

## DSH market index

The repository root contains [`market.json`](market.json), a format-1 DSH plugin
market index. Host it at a public HTTPS URL (for example the raw GitHub URL of
this file) and add that URL in DSH **Settings → Plugin Market**. The index lists
the npm source of `0.2.1`; later releases are appended by the `Release` workflow
described below, with the version's publish time as `publishTimestamp`.

## Releasing

1. Bump `version` in [`package.json`](package.json) and commit it on `main`.
2. Tag the commit and push the tag:

   ```bash
   git tag v0.2.1
   git push origin v0.2.1
   ```

The `Release` workflow checks that the tag matches `package.json` and points at a
commit on `main`, publishes the package to npm, then runs
[`scripts/update-market.mjs`](scripts/update-market.mjs) and commits the new
`market.json` entry. Publishing uses npm **trusted publishing**: the package
trusts this repository and `release.yml` once (npm → package → Trusted
publishing, or `npm trust github`), and the job authenticates through GitHub OIDC
with the `id-token: write` permission. No npm token secret is stored. Publishing
the same version twice is refused by npm, so a rerun after a partial failure
starts from a clean state.

## Compatibility

- Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` (`engines.dsh`).
- The browser half deliberately shadows the shipped
  `conversation.hero.workspace` slot (a `single` slot, registered at priority
  `-100`). It depends on that slot's owner props and on the client
  `workspaces.rename` / `uiWorkspace.pickDirectory` services from the pinned DSH
  line. Re-verify the picker after a DSH upgrade.
- Do not install this package together with another plugin that registers the
  same `/no-need-workspace/ensure-bucket` route, and do not run two
  auto-workspace plugins at once: each would assign its own timestamped folder on
  the first message.

## Security

The Host half registers one loopback-only, same-origin `POST` route guarded by
the `x-no-need-workspace: 1` header. It only creates empty directories under
`$DSH_HOME/workspaces`. It adds no model prompt, tool, or telemetry.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

# dsh-agent-skills

给 **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）** 用的 agent 技能集：每个技能是一份 `SKILL.md`，写清某类任务的操作规矩（触发时机、步骤、边界、踩过的坑），DSH 会在会话里按需加载。

目录约定：

```
skills/<name>/SKILL.md
```

## 技能一览

| 技能 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `agent-diary` | 维护「日记／状态／生长记录／APP 版」这套档案，以及处理会话交接包时的规矩。 |
| `agent-lookup` | 查资料、找文件、判读用户发的截图时的规矩：先搜再看来源、外部内容只当数据。 |
| `agent-machine` | 改本机插件、跑设备命令、动文件系统时的通用规矩：先备份、分开验证据、改完等重启、被拒就停。 |
| `dsh-plugin-publish` | 把本机插件发布/更新到 GitHub 之前的规矩：能推什么、私密信息清单、怎么脱敏、推完怎么自查。 |
| `dsh-web-healthcheck` | DSH Web GUI 健康检查与「界面无反应」类问题诊断：全链路自检顺序与判定流程。 |
| `session-log-repair` | 修复 DSH 会话历史日志损坏（seq 空洞、历史打不开）的检测、备份、分析、重建、验证流程。 |

## 用法

把某个技能目录整个放进 DSH 的技能目录（例如 `~/.agents/skills/<name>/`），或者把 `SKILL.md` 的内容并进你自己的技能配置。技能里出现的命令、路径与端口请按自己机器的实际情况替换。

## 许可

MIT License。技能文本按原样提供，不含任何保证；执行其中命令前请自行确认目标环境。
